summary: Marion County mountaintop state forest lookout, described in 1962 as an 80-ft steel tower with a cab; marked removed. The mountain is now a community.

facts.design: Regular lookout cab on an 80-foot four-legged steel tower (1962 survey description)
facts.status_note: The state survey marks the tower as removed. No source describes what remains at the site.

access.note: The 1962 directions ran up a private road that began at a keep-out sign. The mountain is a community today. No source names who owns the tower site or describes public access to it.

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey described station FC1865 as a state forest lookout tower with a cab on an 80-foot steel tower.
Listed on the state's 1976 list of towers under district-tower number 3-28, as the survey explains its numbering.

corrections.why: The NGS datasheet for station FC1865 gives the mark at 35 04 07.18964 N, 085 22 02.29969 W (NAD 83), on the lookout tower. The record point, taken from the state survey, is about 1 km away.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1962 NGS description names the Tennessee State Forest Service (TSFS); the Forest Lookouts list names the Tennessee Division of Forestry. The facts list the later name.

notes_for_editor: The NGS 1962 description is the only primary source; it gives the tower design and the access route but no build year, and the record's 1962 date is when the station was described, not built. Removal is from the state survey only. The 80-foot figure is the NGS tower height and was not converted to height_m because it may not match the cab-floor height. The location correction moves the point about 1 km to the NGS mark; a human should confirm before applying. The access level was first written as 'private', an inference from the 1962 private road and the summit community. No source names the owner or states an access rule, so the level is now 'unknown' and the story no longer calls the mountain private land. The agency is named differently by NGS (1962) and the Forest Lookouts list; see resolved_conflicts.
